prompt:
Build a Simulink/Simscape longitudinal model of a power-split hybrid-electric passenger vehicle. The physical drivetrain shall include an internal-combustion engine, two motor-generator units, a planetary power-split mechanism, a high-voltage battery with a DC/DC power path, and a driven vehicle/load. These elements must be connected by real mechanical and electrical power paths rather than by prescribed output signals.

Implement closed-loop vehicle-speed tracking from a measured vehicle-speed signal and a time-varying speed reference. A supervisory power-management function shall coordinate engine and electrical power, keep the battery state of charge bounded, and use regenerative braking during deceleration when operating conditions allow it. The system shall remain functional for speed references from standstill through 110 km/h, road grades from -5% through +3%, and initial battery state of charge from 50% through 70%.

Read v_ref_kph, road_grade_pct, and initial_soc_pct from the MATLAB base workspace. v_ref_kph and road_grade_pct may be scalar or Timeseries inputs; initial_soc_pct is a scalar percentage. Record complete Timeseries from simulation start to finish for VehicleSpeed_kph, VehicleSpeedReference_kph, BatterySOC_pct, EnginePower_kW, MG1Power_kW, MG2Power_kW, BatteryPower_kW, BrakeCommand, and RegenCommand. All logs must be measurements or commands from the implemented vehicle and controller, not prescribed result waveforms.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XAUTO06.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
